name: 12298-sharegpt-1b-1gpu
hardware: 1x H100 80GB HBM3 (one GPU of an a3 node, --gres=gpu:1).
architecture: LlamaForCausalLM, 1.24B params, bf16, 16 layers, 32 query / 8 KV heads, head_dim 64 (KV 32 KiB per token); the rest is in the checkpoint's config.json.
load_profile: poisson (OPEN loop), rate = 84 req/s, bounded at 6000 requests / 2400 s safety, first 10% warmup and last 10% cooldown by completion.
workload: guidellm `json_file` over `configs/data/sharegpt-12298-6000.jsonl` -- 6000 real ShareGPT prompts, single turn, no chat template (`request_format: plain`), `temperature: 0.0`, streaming. Each row carries its own `output_tokens_count`, which becomes `max_tokens` with `ignore_eos`, so every request generates exactly its recorded length. Prompt lengths 4..1024 (mean 220.4), output lengths 4..1853 (mean 200.8); 1322102 input and 1205048 generated tokens over the 6000 rows. The file holds 18000 rows; only the first 6000 are read.
purpose: A streaming chat assistant on a compact Llama model, serving 84 conversational prompts per second from one GPU.
launch:
# Engine arguments for item 12298-sharegpt-1b-1gpu, in `vllm serve --config` form. Engine
# defaults are written out explicitly so a later change of default cannot move them.
model: unsloth/Llama-3.2-1B-Instruct
tensor-parallel-size: 1
max-num-batched-tokens: 2048
enable-prefix-caching: false
max-num-seqs: 1024
gpu-memory-utilization: 0.90
dtype: bfloat16
max-model-len: 4096
